scope: Paired measurement in one process: same val batch, same instrument corrected: one config per process, because every variant package registers 'Criterion' into the same gorilla LOSSES registry. Same val batch and same instrument as the historical audits: fvcore FlopCountAnalysis for the FLOPs <= 10.0 G counter, bs=1 with warmup20 / repeat100 median and P90, and peak allocated memory. PIRS changes only the training-time referent target, so an identical forward cost is expected and is reported as measured. The training-time addition is one elementwise IoU and one soft cross-entropy per query per layer; the forward-only FLOPs counter does not capture it and it is stated rather than claimed as free.
